name: hcportal_regenerateExtApiKey
description: Regenerates the external API key (Kennel.ExtApiKey) for a kennel. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @publicKennelId in the token param string. The caller must supply the current key, and must hold AppAccessFlags & 0x40000019 (authIsAdmin 0x1 | 0x8 | 0x10 | SuperAdmin 0x40000000) on the kennel — a hard-coded mask, not the Permissions V2 matrix. Generates a 75-character key from CRYPT_GEN_RANDOM(150), base64 with '+' and '/' stripped, and writes it in a transaction.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: The kennel whose API key is being regenerated. Changed from NVARCHAR(250) in HC5 to UNIQUEIDENTIFIER in HC6. Validated IS NULL after auth. Kennel must exist.

parameters.name: currentExtApiKey
parameters.description: Security: the current external API key. Must exactly match Kennel.ExtApiKey for the resolved kennel. Narrowed from NVARCHAR(1000) in HC5 to NVARCHAR(120) in HC6 to match the table column.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on auth failure, NULL @publicKennelId, unknown kennel, wrong current key, missing permission, or from the CATCH block (ERROR_MESSAGE()). Short-circuits.

rowsets.name: SuccessResult
rowsets.description: Returned (alone, no Success column) when the key has been regenerated.

columns.name: newExtApiKey
columns.description: The new key (75 characters), held in an NVARCHAR(1000) local.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Kennel.ExtApiKey — overwrites the existing API key with the newly generated value
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change the AppAccessFlags permission bitmask (0x40000019) without coordinating with all callers

codeSmells.issue: CATCH block does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 126-129: CATCH rolls back and returns the envelope with no HC.ErrorLog row.

codeSmells.issue: Refusal message is NULL for a caller with no kennel row
codeSmells.detail: Lines 94-105: @kennelName is read through the caller's HasherKennelMap row; when there is none, 'You are not authorized … for ' + NULL yields a NULL ErrorMessage. The wording ('access Hasher information') is also copied from another SP.
Lines 81-88 test the supplied key before the permission check on lines 91-106, so any signed-in portal user can learn whether a guessed key is correct for any kennel.

codeSmells.issue: Success shape differs from the error shape
codeSmells.detail: Line 123: success returns only newExtApiKey, with no Success column; clients must detect success by the column name.
